name: 15009-batchdecode-llama4scout-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E, bf16: a re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E with the same weights; the Llama 4 Community License applies.
parallelism: tp8 over the eight GPUs of one node. No PP, no DP, no EP, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, mixture of experts, 109B total with 17B active, bf16. 48 decoder layers, 40 query and 8 key/value heads at head_dim 128, 16 experts with 1 active per token. Text only; the checkpoint's vision tower is not entered.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup discards the first 20%, bounded at 640 requests with a 2700 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: exactly 1000 prompt tokens and exactly 1000 output tokens, both with stdev 0, `prefix_tokens: 0`. temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request generates its full 1000 tokens regardless of what it samples.
purpose: A long-form text generation service on a 109B mixture-of-experts model, 128 concurrent single-turn requests across eight GPUs.
launch:
# A re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E with the same bf16 weights; the Llama 4
# Community License applies. Pin the revision if the re-upload is ever republished:
# 62d69dc0a79bb9251fe44d1397ddf34fc23e1068.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E
tp-size: 8
context-length: 2048
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true
max-running-requests: 128
dtype: bfloat16
